name: Nemuri Hime Makan
source:
Sleeping Beauty Defiled (Nemuri-hime Makan) lets you choose
how to enjoy a roofied young girl. 
The main storyline takes place in the bedroom, but there is also
a bonus part set in the night park. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098773.html]DLSite English[/url]]
